title: Remove hardcoded Rust credentials
why: A credential stored in source can leak through version history, packages, logs, or compiled artifacts.
suggestion: Load the secret from a dedicated secret store or environment boundary and keep only non-sensitive identifiers in source.
limitations: Only direct string literals assigned to credential-shaped const, static, or let names are inspected.
Runtime data flow, generated source, encrypted literals, and secrets returned by macros are not resolved.
